sentence_example: Nach dem Essen muss ich noch das Geschirr spülen.
sentence_example_translation_en: After eating I still have to wash the dishes.
sentence_example_translation_ru: После еды мне еще нужно помыть посуду.
sentence_synonym: Nach dem Essen muss ich noch das Geschirr abwaschen.
typical_collocations: Geschirr spülen; Gläser spülen; den Mund spülen; an Land spülen
usage_comments_en: 'Spülen' can mean to wash dishes (often 'Geschirr spülen') or to rinse (e.g., 'den Mund spülen'). It can also mean to wash up ashore ('an den Strand spülen'). Contrast with 'waschen' (general washing, e.g., clothes/hands) and 'abwaschen' (specifically washing up dishes).

word_translation_en: to wash up (dishes), to rinse off, to wash away
sentence_example: Nach dem Abendessen müssen wir das Geschirr abspülen.
sentence_example_translation_en: After dinner, we have to wash the dishes.
sentence_example_translation_ru: После ужина нам нужно помыть посуду.
sentence_synonym: Nach dem Abendessen müssen wir das Geschirr abwaschen.
typical_collocations: Geschirr abspülen; den Dreck abspülen; Seife abspülen
usage_comments_en: Very common word. Refers to rinsing something under running water, most commonly used for washing dishes ('Geschirr abspülen') or rinsing soap and dirt off surfaces.

word_translation_en: to wash up; to deposit by water
sentence_example: Das Meer hat viel Sand am Ufer aufgespült.
sentence_example_translation_en: The sea washed up a lot of sand on the shore.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Море намыло много песка на берег.
sentence_synonym: Das Meer hat viel Sand am Ufer angeschwemmt.
usage_comments_en: Mainly used in coastal engineering and hydrology for accumulating sand or soil via water. Separable verb, governs accusative.

sentence_example: Er muss sich nach dem Zähneputzen den Mund gründlich ausspülen.
sentence_example_translation_en: He has to rinse his mouth thoroughly after brushing his teeth.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Он должен тщательно прополоскать рот после чистки зубов.
sentence_synonym: Er muss sich nach dem Zähneputzen den Mund gründlich auswaschen.
typical_collocations: den Mund ausspülen; die Flasche ausspülen; die Wunde ausspülen
usage_comments_en: Refers to cleaning the inside of a container, mouth, or wound by using a liquid. Separable verb taking an accusative object.

word_translation_en: to lap against; to wash against
sentence_example_translation_en: Gentle waves lap against the beach.
typical_collocations: vom Meer bespült werden; das Ufer bespülen
usage_comments_en: Inseparable verb, typically poetic or elevated register. Often used in passive constructions to describe shores or rocks being hit by water.

word_translation_en: to flush, to rinse thoroughly, to irrigate
sentence_example: Der Zahnarzt muss den Kanal gründlich durchspülen.
sentence_example_translation_en: The dentist has to flush the canal thoroughly.
sentence_synonym: Der Zahnarzt muss den Kanal gründlich ausspülen.
typical_collocations: den Mund durchspülen; Rohre durchspülen; Wunden durchspülen
usage_comments_en: To clean by running a large amount of water or specialized liquid completely through a system, pipe, anatomical cavity, wound, or mouth.

word_translation_en: to wash in; to flush in
sentence_example: Der Regen hat Schlamm in den Keller eingespült.
sentence_example_translation_en: The rain washed mud into the cellar.
sentence_synonym: Der Regen hat Schlamm in den Keller hineingespült.
usage_comments_en: Separable verb denoting carrying or washing particles into a place or soil with water. Often used in agriculture or geology.

word_translation_ru: прибивать к берегу; выносить на берег
sentence_example: Das Meer hat Treibholz an die Küste angespült.
sentence_example_translation_en: The sea washed driftwood onto the coast.
sentence_synonym: Das Meer hat Treibholz an die Küste angeschwemmt.
usage_comments_en: Separable transitive verb. Describes water carrying an object to a coast or bank. Often seen in passive voice (wurde an den Strand angespült).

word_translation_en: to wash away; to sweep away
sentence_example: Die Flut hat die kleine Brücke fortgespült.
sentence_example_translation_en: The flood washed away the small bridge.
sentence_synonym: Die Flut hat die kleine Brücke weggespült.
typical_collocations: von den Wellen fortgespült werden; Erde fortspülen
usage_comments_en: Separable verb with prefix fort-. Highly synonymous with 'wegspülen', expressing removal or destruction caused by a current of water.

word_translation_en: to rinse afterwards; to wash down
sentence_example: Man sollte das Geschirr immer mit klarem Wasser nachspülen.
sentence_example_translation_en: One should always rinse dishes with clean water afterwards.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Следует всегда ополаскивать посуду чистой водой.
sentence_synonym: Man sollte das Geschirr immer mit klarem Wasser nachwaschen.
typical_collocations: mit Wasser nachspülen; die Seife nachspülen
usage_comments_en: Separable verb indicating a subsequent washing/rinsing step to remove detergent, or swallowing liquid to wash down medicine.

sentence_example: Riesige Wellen überspülten das Deck des Schiffes.
sentence_example_translation_en: Giant waves washed over the deck of the ship.
sentence_synonym: Riesige Wellen überfluteten das Deck des Schiffes.
typical_collocations: die Straße überspülen; das Ufer überspülen
usage_comments_en: Inseparable verb, stress on '-spülen'. It takes an accusative object representing the surface being covered or swept by water.

word_translation_en: to flow around; to lap around
sentence_example: Das kühle Wasser umspült die nackten Füße.
sentence_example_translation_en: The cool water laps around bare feet.
sentence_synonym: Das kühle Wasser umfließt die nackten Füße.
typical_collocations: eine Insel umspülen; die Beine umspülen
usage_comments_en: Inseparable verb (umspült, umspülte, hat umspült). Often literary, depicting gentle movement of water encircling an object.

word_translation_en: to undermine; to hollow out (by water)
sentence_example: Der reißende Fluss hat das Fundament des Hauses unterspült.
sentence_example_translation_en: The torrential river undermined the foundation of the house.
sentence_synonym: Der reißende Fluss hat das Fundament des Hauses ausgehöhlt.
typical_collocations: die Schienen unterspülen; ein Ufer unterspülen
usage_comments_en: Inseparable verb with stress on the verb stem. Frequently found in news reports about flood damage or structural hazards.

word_translation_en: to wash away, to flush away
sentence_example: Die Flut hat die Sandburgen am Strand weggespült.
sentence_example_translation_en: The flood washed away the sandcastles on the beach.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Прилив смыл песчаные замки на пляже.
sentence_synonym: Die Flut hat die Sandburgen am Strand wegwaschen.
typical_collocations: Dreck wegspülen; Sorgen wegspülen; den Staub wegspülen
usage_comments_en: Implies the removal of dirt or objects by a strong stream or volume of water (like a flood, river, or rain). Often used in poetic or figurative senses (e.g., washing away worries).
